mapper.select: SELECT id, batch_name, usage_date, status, status_updated_at, run_started_at, finished_at, target_count, success_count, failed_count, skipped_count, processed_count_updated_at, manager_instance_id, last_error_code, last_error_message, created_at FROM LINE_DAILY_BATCH_JOB WHERE batch_name = #{batchName} AND usage_date = #{usageDate} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, batch_name, usage_date, status, status_updated_at, run_started_at, finished_at, target_count, success_count, failed_count, skipped_count, processed_count_updated_at, manager_instance_id, last_error_code, last_error_message, created_at FROM LINE_DAILY_BATCH_JOB WHERE batch_name = #{batchName} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, batch_name, usage_date, status, status_updated_at, run_started_at, finished_at, target_count, success_count, failed_count, skipped_count, processed_count_updated_at, manager_instance_id, last_error_code, last_error_message, created_at FROM LINE_DAILY_BATCH_JOB WHERE batch_name = 'LINE_DAILY_USAGE_SYNC_BATCH' AND usage_date = #{usageDate} AND status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LINE_DAILY_BATCH_JOB ( batch_name, usage_date, status, status_updated_at, target_count, success_count, failed_count, skipped_count, created_at ) VALUES ( #{batchName}, #{usageDate}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), #{targetCount}, #{successCount}, #{failedCount}, #{skippedCount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) )

INSERT INTO LINE_DAILY_BATCH_JOB ( batch_name, usage_date, status, status_updated_at, run_started_at, target_count, success_count, failed_count, skipped_count, created_at ) VALUES ( 'LINE_DAILY_USAGE_SYNC_BATCH', #{usageDate}, 'RUNNING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), #{targetCount}, 0, 0, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.update: UPDATE LINE_DAILY_BATCH_JOB SET status = #{status}, status_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), run_started_at = COALESCE(run_started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), manager_instance_id = #{managerInstanceId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE LINE_DAILY_BATCH_JOB SET status = 'COMPLETED', status_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), target_count = #{targetCount}, success_count = #{targetCount}, failed_count = 0, skipped_count = 0, processed_count_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND batch_name = 'LINE_DAILY_TARGET_INSERT_BATCH' AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE LINE_DAILY_BATCH_JOB SET status = 'RUNNING', status_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), run_started_at = COALESCE(run_started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), target_count = #{targetCount}, manager_instance_id = #{managerInstanceId} WHERE id = #{id} AND batch_name = 'LINE_DAILY_USAGE_SYNC_BATCH' AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE LINE_DAILY_BATCH_JOB SET success_count = success_count + CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, skipped_count = skipped_count + CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} = 'SKIPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, failed_count = failed_count + CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, processed_count_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND batch_name = 'LINE_DAILY_USAGE_SYNC_BATCH' AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE LINE_DAILY_BATCH_JOB SET success_count = success_count + #{successDelta}, skipped_count = skipped_count + #{skippedDelta}, processed_count_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{batchJobId} AND batch_name = 'LINE_DAILY_USAGE_SYNC_BATCH' AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE LINE_DAILY_BATCH_JOB SET status = 'COMPLETED', status_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND batch_name = 'LINE_DAILY_USAGE_SYNC_BATCH' AND status = 'RUNNING' AND target_count = success_count + failed_count + skipped_count

UPDATE LINE_DAILY_BATCH_JOB SET status = 'COMPLETED', status_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND batch_name = #{batchName} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE LINE_DAILY_BATCH_JOB SET status = 'RUNNING', status_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), run_started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), finished_at = NULL, manager_instance_id = #{managerInstanceId}, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND batch_name = #{batchName} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'ABANDONED')
